verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an extensible commerce platform, but the evidence never documents a built-in scheduler or recurring workflow feature. Webhooks are event-triggered one-off notifications, not schedules. Subscription products are recurring customer billing, not scheduled jobs. The REST API, CLI and MCP are building blocks that would need an external scheduler, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
